metadata.case_name: THELMA G. CHAVEZ AND OTHERS v. FONG KA YIU, FRANK

plaintiff.occupation_before: Domestic helper (worked for a number of different Japanese families)
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: cashier, office clerk, shop assistant, telephone operator and sedentary type of factory worker; possibly cosmetician
plaintiff.education_level: Qualifications from the Philippines in work related to cosmetics

injuries.description: fracture of the 5th metacarpal of the right hand
source: i) fracture of the 5th metacarpal of the right hand;
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of other metacarpal bone, unspecified

injuries.description: fracture of the ulna of the right forearm
source: ii) fracture of the ulna of the right forearm;
iii) fracture of the right femur;

injuries.description: compound fracture of the right tibia and fibula, being a comminuted fracture with external wound
source: iv) compound fracture of the right tibia and fibula, being a comminuted fracture with external wound.

manifestations.description: weakness of right upper arm and right hand grip
pain in right leg and knee
shortened right lower limb (2 cm length discrepancy)
ugly scars and unstable ulcers in right leg
fixed flexion deformity of the joint of the little finger
residual pain from fracture of the right ulna
slight wasting of the thigh muscle
gross stiffness and weakness of the ankle joint caused by scarring and adhesion of the muscle and tendons around the fracture site
reduced plantarflexion action of the ankle joint due to muscle transfer

treatments_received: nailing and fixations of the fractures (operations on 1 and 2 July)
re-adjustment of the fixations (operations on 5 and 9 July)
muscle flap coverage of soft tissue defect

losses.description: Multiple ugly and conspicuous permanent scars including large dark pigmented skin graft areas, conspicuous surgical scars across right forearm, pelvis, hip, knee and right lower leg; cosmetic disability assessed at 8% and permanent
Reduced mobility of the right leg including gross stiffness and weakness of the ankle, difficulty squatting, reduced ankle flexion, shortened right lower limb
Permanent impairment including fixed flexion deformity of the little finger, residual pain in right ulna, 2 cm shortening of right femur and wasting of thigh muscle
